contents.skills/connecting-external-capabilities/:
---
name: connecting-external-capabilities
description: Use for ND multi-step external-integration work, when connecting external systems, adding or qualifying a custom/remote MCP, or when an MCP, API, connector, or tool is missing, not exposed, partially failing, blocked by OAuth/authentication or provider limits, or needs an alternate route, fallback, relay, bridge, browser, or device path.
---
# Connecting External Capabilities

SKILL_URI = skills://plugins/nd-external-connecting/connecting-external-capabilities
GENERATION_URI = skills://plugins/nd-generation/nd-launch-generation
TRUE_DOCTOR_URI = skills://plugins/nd-true-doctor/nd-launch-true-doctor
AUTOMATION_AGENT_URI = skills://plugins/nd-automation-agent/nd-launch-automation-agent

## Binding principles
`CAPABILITY FIRST, ROUTE SECOND` and `FAILED_ROUTE != FAILED_CAPABILITY` are mandatory.
Preserve the original caller/owner/return target. This skill NEVER acquires substantive ownership and NEVER creates an ND cognitive identity outside ChatGPT.

## Anti-Hang
EVERY external integration/recovery operation remains inside CURRENT Anti-Hang safe-cycle control. There is no timebox/user-interrupt choreography. A safe-cycle boundary means `SAFE_CYCLE_ROTATE -> AUTO_CONTINUE`, never “wait for Go”. Consequential writes use PREPARE -> WRITE -> READBACK; ambiguous effects are reconciled before retry.

## Mandatory entry condition
Generation invokes this skill when no existing CURRENT qualified route can satisfy the required semantic capability, or when a new/alternate route must be created/qualified. Direct user requests to connect/qualify a capability may also enter here.

## Mandatory route creation/qualification sequence
1. Recover semantic goal, original owner, authority and current evidence.
2. Inventory native/direct/plugin/MCP/API/browser/host routes and existing infrastructure before provisioning. Apply REUSE -> EXTEND -> CREATE.
3. When applicable, inspect existing Vercel, Railway, Render, GitHub and other available hosting/control surfaces before creating new infrastructure.
4. Build/repair/qualify the smallest route that satisfies required semantics.
5. Prove OPERATION_QUALIFIED; for consequential mutation prove WRITE_QUALIFIED by provider readback.
6. If the route becomes adopted/current, update the relevant route registry/resolver and canonical Generation projection according to CURRENT publication rules.
7. RETURN to the original already-live caller and resume/retry the original semantic operation automatically.

A failed individual host/provider/credential projection is not permission to abandon recovery. Continue through materially distinct authorized routes until capability restoration or a true irreducible authority/safety/payment/credential/provider/resource gate.

## Evidence gates
EXPOSED != OPERATION_QUALIFIED != WRITE_QUALIFIED. Visibility/tools-list is never enough for production adoption.

## Cognitive boundary
Binding: ND-COGNITIVE-RUNTIME-1. External systems are tools/routes only; they MUST NOT host or impersonate Automation Agent, Supervisors, Children or Critics.
